## Recovered observations

78 points (from FC-20) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b11`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: points at the FC-5A angles and Dr (29, 32.8, 36.9, 41.5 deg), a circle at Dr about .01 near 29.8 deg (FC-13), and a further circle at Dr about 1.0 near 41.5 deg not traced to any App. C figure; S-shaped average plus two dashed bounds
- Codex: Markers and average with dashed limits. Some underlying tests unidentified; geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-20, printed C-42, PDF 156
